title: Where Duke's nickname 'Dumpy' came from
summary: Bigard thinks the name came from Freddie Guy and Sonny Greer and says Duke disliked being called it.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Where did he get the nickname Dumpy?
I don't know. I think from Freddie Guy. I think he got that from him, him and Sonny Greer.
Because I know you called him Dumpy sometimes, or Dump, didn't you?
Yeah, I called him that. He don't like that name. I used to call it to him anyhow, bam. So let's cool it for a while. [PAUSE]
